title: Installing and Connecting Wrangler
description: Commands that install Wrangler, log in to your Cloudflare account, and confirm the connection.

steps.description: These commands install Wrangler, Cloudflare's command-line tool. `npm install -g wrangler` installs it globally, and `wrangler --version` confirms it is there.
The comment notes you can run `npx wrangler` instead to use it without a global install.
`wrangler login` opens a browser tab and asks you to authorize Cloudflare to connect to your account.
`wrangler whoami` confirms your account is connected.
